t: The Brenner 5Ltr Carpet Cleaner is a concentrated liquid designed for deep cleaning carpets and rugs. This formula is ideal for caretakers, trade cleaners, and facilities management staff maintaining busy offices, schools, or residential rentals. The concentrated solution lifts deep-seated dirt, dust, and stubborn stains to restore tired carpet fibres. Specially formulated for use with most spray extraction machines, it delivers reliable results on high-traffic areas, leaving carpets fresh and clean after just 1 application.
b: Made For Spray Extraction Cleaning Machines
